review.shorterRoute: Reuse the existing subgroup-preimage coset map and its automatic injectivity, literal coinduced coefficient trace, and original Shapiro restriction/evaluation identity. Pullback of coinduced functions proves trace compatibility at coefficient level by finite sum reindexing; native functoriality then supplies H1 base change. This avoids reconstructing a degree-one Mackey resolution or orbit homotopy from the existing degree-two result.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: Derive the native H1 trace base-change identity from an explicit group-level coset-surjectivity condition. The intended actual application must separately derive that condition for its original Gamma1/Hecke square; no cohomological identity may be assumed.
review.remaining: Base change alone is a supporting obligation. Apply it to the literal square and prove the required trace composition and coefficient comparisons to obtain actual surjective-transfer Hecke compatibility. Arithmetic geometry/diamonds, Galois realization, all-weight association, local/image/regularity, automorphy and higher continuation remain. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
